name: G42
verdict: G42 is anchor-invested by Mubadala, Abu Dhabi's sovereign wealth fund, and is chaired by Sheikh Tahnoon bin Zayed (ruling family) - UAE state money, rated serious….
note: Rating note: Ownership: Mubadala portfolio page - G42 'backed by Mubadala, Silver Lake, Microsoft and Dalio Family Office' (https://www.mubadala.com/en/what-we-do/g42). Mubadala is a shareholder, not sole owner, so 'part-owned'. Mercedes F1 sponsor.

why.text: G42’s anchor investor is Mubadala, Abu Dhabi’s sovereign wealth fund, and the company is chaired by a member of Abu Dhabi’s ruling family. The UAE’s courts have upheld the convictions from an unfair mass trial of activists and dissidents. A famous team makes the country look good to millions of fans while that goes on. That’s called sportswashing.
why.messageLine: The UAE’s courts upheld the convictions from an unfair mass trial of activists and dissidents.
